headline: Discussed 2027 budget and possible solutions for financial issues, plus a proposed Hamden Jazz Concert series.
summary: Doc Martin reviewed the October 27 special meeting on the Hamden Through Time 240 project and talked briefly about planned art with the Youth Commissioners. Members also discussed new projects and fundraisers to pursue. Ryan, Charles, and Doc will meet to discuss the full scope of the financial issues.
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ARTS COMMISSION 
AND 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL  
COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE 
MEETING MINUTES 
 
November 4, 2026 
 
7:00pm 
 
Hamden Government Center 
Third Floor Conference Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
 
 
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 Doc Martin called the meeting to order at 7:09PM. 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 In - person: Doc Martin, Chloe Fang, Donna Elkins 
Online: Marita Gargiulo, Ryan Brown, Quinn Wainwright, Charles Kortrsep, 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 No public comment received. 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  1. September 2nd  
  Doc reviewed the September meeting minutes. 
Marita Gargiulo made a motion to approve the minutes and Donna Elkin seconded. 
  2. October 27th - Special Meeting  
  
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No correspondence received.
6. REPORTS 
  
 No reports. 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No executive session needed. 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  1. Hamden Through Time 240 Project Update  
  Doc Martin reviewed the 10.27.26 special meeting and briefly discussed planned art 
with the Youth Commissioners. 
 
 
  2. Discussion on new projects and fundraisers for the Hamden Arts Commission to 
pursue  
  
 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  1. Discussion on our proposed budget going forward in 2027 
 
  
  The Commission reviewed money issues and possible solutions. 
Ryan, Charles, and Doc will meet to discuss the full scope of the financial issues. 
  2. Present and discuss proposal for a Hamden Jazz Concert series  
  Doc Martin probed each Commissioner for what they wanted to see in 2027 
programming. 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 Marita Gargiulo made a motion to adjourn the meeting. Donna Elkin seconded the motion. 
Meeting adjourned at 8:19PM.
